content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 indicates a contractual bundling denial, not an established patient obligation, so billing the balance to the patient is not appropriate. Prior authorization is not required, and no claim-data error or information request supports those rework options. Although an earlier appeal failed and peer-to-peer review is available, another medical-necessity appeal is not prohibited by the published rules and has the strongest demonstrated recovery among similar claims (2/5 paid).","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
